name: Basin and petroleum systems modelling
principle: Software reconstructs burial, heat flow and fluid flow in a sedimentary basin to estimate when and where source rocks generated oil or gas, how it migrated and whether a trap was in place. The general framework is source rock, burial heat, migration, reservoir, seal and trap.
